description: This file contains the implementation of the Shipping class in the OpenCart e-commerce system. It defines methods for handling shipping-related operations such as retrieving shipping details, calculating quotes, and saving shipping preferences. The class interacts with session data, models, and configurations to manage shipping information within the order process.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Class responsible for handling shipping operations, including calculating shipping quotes, saving shipping details, and rendering shipping information during checkout.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method for retrieving and displaying shipping information based on current session and configuration settings.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Generates shipping quotes based on provided address data and available shipping methods, returning JSON with the results.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves selected shipping method and updates session data accordingly, returning JSON status.
